summary: Iteration 320 — Frontend Testing of Chat Bug Fix + Toast Feature + Branding Crop Dialog. All 3 features verified: (1) Chat real-time fix with 300ms re-fetch + safety useEffect, (2) Enhanced chat toast popup with 360px card, pulsing dot, 'Antworten →' button, (3) BrandingCropDialog for logo (1:1) and virtual background (16:9) with zoom/pan.

issues: Push notification banner shown - expected behavior for browsers without push permission

critical_code_review_comments: Bug 1 Fix (Chat Real-time): Lines 211-224 in ChatPage.js add 300ms delayed re-fetch after WS new-message event. Lines 364-378 add safety re-fetch useEffect watching conversations list for missing message_id.

Feature 2 (Chat Toast): ChatUnreadContext.js lines 119-156 implement toast.custom with 360px width, pulsing red dot, sender initials avatar, 'NEUE CHAT-NACHRICHT' label, 3-line preview, 'Antworten →' button, 10s auto-dismiss.
Feature 3a (Virtual Background Crop): BrandingPanel.js uses BrandingCropDialog with 16:9 aspect, 1920x1080 target. Recrop button appears when background exists.
Feature 3b (Logo Crop): BrandingSettings.js uses BrandingCropDialog with 1:1 aspect, 256x256 target. Recrop button (data-testid='branding-recrop-logo') visible when logo exists.
BrandingCropDialog.js: 174 lines, uses react-easy-crop, supports configurable aspect/targetWidth/targetHeight/title/description, outputs JPEG blob at 92% quality.
ESLint Warning: ChatPage.js line 265 has missing dependency 'fetchMessages' in useEffect - minor, doesn't affect functionality.
